title: Finding card: a faint serif 'Finding N: topic' above a one-sentence claim, three crayon bars on graph paper with derived values, a legend, an asterisk footnote and a bold italic 'How to read this' line
use: A research finding with three scenarios or categories. value_1..3 and max are parameters: the value text and the bar come from the same number.

max.note: the value at the end of the track

claim.default: 每个情景下支出都会增长，但幅度相差一个数量级

fig_title.default: 2028 年全球 AI 资本开支，相对 2025 年的变化*

footnote.default: *按 2025 年美元计价 · 示例数据，仅用于展示模板

howto.default: 每根条的长度是相对 2025 年的增幅，右侧是增幅百分比。

relations: 'Finding N' 30 units faint serif (large type: 3.5:1); claim 36 serif ink; the figure on graph paper starts 100 units under the claim.
Bars 34 high on a 76 pitch, a 880-unit track from x 400; values to the right of the track, labels to the left, never text on a bar.
Legend squares 14 units, footnote 14 sans centred, the how-to-read line in a 640-unit column (lead-in bold italic, 10 units before its sentence).
decoration: Graph paper (22 units, 1 unit lines), the crayon filter, the neutral track tiles and the baseline are decoration.

provenance.corpus: research-report kit (examples/institute-essay-report-kit): our own original long-read page in the institute-essay grammar; all copy and numbers are placeholders
provenance.experiment: styles/institute-essay/style.json provenance (two public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: A finding block and its full-width figure from the reference pages, set as one card; bars taken from the measured figure style (rounded 3, crayon-textured).
measured: 'Finding N: topic' faint serif about 28 px above a one-sentence claim in ink serif about 28 px; figure on 22 px graph paper with a bold italic 'How to read this:' caption.
Template: value and bar share one parameter; checked at both sizes, light and dark.
